quotes.text: The recorded BCT4 triage says `AccessibilityUtils.assertCanBeClicked()` evaluated the composed click target and its nearest interactive accessible. A clickable-looking parent therefore did not establish that a synthetic click on a descendant passed the check. Use this observation when a current accessibility failure names a descendant or wrapper, after confirming the current checker and target. The recorded local fixes did not by themselves prove that the selected Linux CI run passed.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
